title: This bed frame holds a lot of weight!
text:
This bed frame holds a lot of weight!. My husband and I are both big people. He is 6ft2in, weight 450lbs. I am 5ft 9in and 350 lbs. We are 800lbs of active people. Now add 150lbs of foam
mattress, this is a sturdy frame.
We had a similar frame for 10 yrs
and some of the welds broke. Time to replace mattress take the
time to look over the frame. It
works as hard as the mattress.
My husband has put all his long
rifles and scopes under the bed. Plenty of room, to store suitcases
or totes or boxes. The process of
putting the frame together.
Hardest part was getting past the
packing tape. No tools were
needed. Clip fit into the frame to
hold it together for a Cal king bed
frame. Put on mattress, make the
bed and sleep well, in style!

description: Classic Brands Hercules Heavy-Duty 14-Inch Metal Bed Frame/Foundation

is a solidly constructed super strong metal bed frame that provides superior support for most mattresses. It is a low-cost alternative to traditional bed frames, foundations or box springs. This durable black metal frame supports every type of mattress and has 13 inches of ample storage space beneath. Ships ready to assemble with no tools needed. It can also fit most headboards and footboards (brackets sold separately).
Is it a Foundation or a Frame?

This is a common question-the Hercules Heavy-Duty 14-Inch Metal Bed Frame is both. It provides support for the mattress, so no foundation or box spring is required, and it has the rigid surface and legs like that as of a bed frame. If you want to add a foundation, you can do that as well. With ample storage space beneath and caps on the legs to protect your floor, this is a perfect solution to support any type of mattress.
Benefits of Hercules Platform Heavy Duty Metal Bed Frame/Foundation

The Classic Brands Hercules Platform Heavy Duty Metal Bed Frame/Mattress Foundation is a great alternative to a traditional mattress foundation. The metal bed frame replaces a traditional box spring, giving your bed a more modern look while creating more room for under bed storage. All standard bed sizes are available, and the metal frame can support any type of mattress - memory foam, latex, or innerspring. It also prevents sagging and increases the longevity of a mattress. The metal foundation has a sleek, contemporary look while providing the ultimate allover support for your mattress with 12 points of contact to the floor.

The quad-folding metal box spring is easy to assemble; it can be put together in minutes and no tools are needed for assembly. Just unpack, assemble the frame and attach the hardware and you are ready to place your mattress on top:

•Step 1- Take all components out of the box and position them on the floor •Step 2- Unfold each half and lay flat •Step 3- Raise all six legs to the upright position. Each of the four end legs has separate support arms •Step 4- Rotate the support arms to hook onto the bolts and tighten with installed wing nuts  •Step 5- Flip the base over to stand upright. Position the two halves together with keyhole locked in place •Step 6- Put your mattress (and foundation if you please) on top and enjoy!
Get it Right the First Time

It is also a good idea to check the size and the height of your mattress to make sure you are ordering the correct size. Keep in mind that you should combine the height of the frame, foundation (if you are adding one), and the mattress to get a gauge of the how tall your bed will be.
